lines.say: switches on GLP-1 and glucagon receptors; its maker calls it an oxyntomodulin analog
11.0% and 14.0% less body weight in 48 weeks, versus 0.3% on placebo (Chinese adults)
about 1.4 to 2.0 points lower HbA1c than placebo in type 2 diabetes (company-reported)
liver enzymes and liver fat lower than on placebo (company-reported)
blood fats and uric acid lower than on placebo (company-reported)
resting heart rate checked, as the semaglutide label calls for
nausea, diarrhea and vomiting, mostly mild to moderate; few stopped over side effects
approved GLP-1s carry a rodent thyroid tumor warning; unknown whether it applies
